tools.name: list_loan_products
tools.description: List eLEND loan products for a channel. Returns product names, descriptions and URLs. Contains no rates, APRs or approval criteria -- never infer those.

channel.description: "direct" for consumer products, "tpo" for partner products.

tools.name: prefill_enquiry_form
tools.description: Fill in the enquiry form on the current page with details the user has given you. IMPORTANT: this only populates fields. It never submits. Tell the user to review what was entered and press submit themselves, because submitting is how they consent to being contacted about a loan.

message.description: What the user wants to ask.

tools.name: search_elend
tools.description: Search eLEND for pages, loan products, articles and team members. Use this before answering any question about what eLEND offers. Does not return rates or eligibility decisions, which are not published on the site.

channel.description: "direct" for consumers seeking a mortgage, "tpo" for brokers and correspondent partners, "any" to search both.
